name: a100_lite_m64
description: The a100_lite SM at 64 SMs, the memory system scaled to 64/108 of the A100's (a100_lite's rule).

sources.inherited (a100_lite): the SM, and the rule that scales the memory system with the SMs
sources.L2_SIZE 32 MiB: the full 32 MiB from 64 SMs (the a100 profile's L2; 0.3 MiB x 64 = 19.2 MiB)
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_PEAK_BW 921481, DATA_RAT: 1555000 MB/s x 64 / 108; 32 HBM2 channels x 16 B x 1800 MT/s = 921600 MB/s
